title: Khusrau and Shirin and the Fisherman
logline: A fisherman sells a king one fish and, by answering two traps set by the queen with quick wit, walks out with three rewards instead of one.
moral: A quick, courteous mind can turn every test into a reward.
tone: Light court comedy: a calm clever commoner, an impulsive laughing king, a cool calculating queen, and a servant who has to carry every sack. The humour is in looks, the fan and the emptying vault, never in mockery of the fisherman.

beats.summary: The fisherman brings a rare great fish to the fish-loving king.
The king orders 4000 dirhams; Shirin's fan snaps shut.
Shirin objects: too much, the courtiers will resent it.
The king will not break a promise made in public.
Shirin's trick: male or female? Either answer loses the money.
The fisherman hears the question and thinks.
It is both. The trap closes on nothing.
One coin falls; he puts the whole sack down for it.
The king is angry and summons him.
The coin bears the king's image and name; he saved it from being trodden on.
He leaves with twelve thousand instead of four.
The king's stern decree, undercut by the empty vault and the queen's look.

Planned wordless picture balloon (iconBalloon, single mode): white balloon with a tail to the speaker and flat icons inside. Icons needed here: sack with number, courtier head with purse (x3), balanceScale, fish blue / pink / half and half, bending fisherman, servant with open hand, struck sack with coinEyes face.
Library thoughtCloud for Shirin's plan (S5, S6), the king's fish daydream (S1) and the fisherman's market worry (S14).

Planned scroll (long): paper band 150 wide, len up to 420, squiggle lines only, rolled end that falls and bounces.

subtitles.ar: كان الملك كسرى يحب أكل السمك،|وفي يوم دخل عليه صياد يحمل سمكة كبيرة نادرة.|كان الملك جالسًا مع زوجته شيرين،|فأعجب بالسمكة، وأمر أن يعطى الصياد أربعة آلاف درهم مكافأة له.
subtitles.en: King Khusrau loved fish.|When a fisherman brought him a fine large fish,|he ordered a reward of four thousand dirhams|as Queen Shirin watched.

subtitles.ar: قالت شيرين إن المكافأة كبيرة،|فقد يظن رجال القصر أن هدايا الملك لهم قليلة|إذا ساوت هدية صياد بسيط.|أجاب كسرى أنه لا يحب الرجوع في وعد قطعه أمام الناس.
subtitles.en: Shirin thought the payment excessive:|courtiers might resent receiving as much|as a fisherman.|Khusrau replied that a king should not withdraw a promised gift.

subtitles.ar: اقترحت شيرين حيلة،|وهي أن يسأل الملك الصياد هل السمكة ذكر أم أنثى.|فإن أجاب أنها ذكر، يطلب الملك أنثى، وإن قال أنثى، يطلب ذكرًا،|فيسترد المال.
subtitles.en: Shirin proposed|asking whether the fish was male or female,|then demanding the opposite kind|so the reward could be reclaimed.

subtitles.ar: عاد الصياد وسمع السؤال، لكنه كان حاضر الذهن.|قال إن هذه السمكة ليست ذكرًا فقط ولا أنثى فقط، بل تجمع الصفتين.|ضحك كسرى من الجواب الذكي،|وأمر له بأربعة آلاف درهم أخرى.
subtitles.en: Summoned back, the quick-witted fisherman|replied that the fish was both male and female.|Khusrau laughed|and granted him four thousand dirhams more.

subtitles.ar: تسلم الرجل ثمانية آلاف درهم في كيس،|وحمله على كتفه ليخرج من القصر.|سقط منه درهم واحد،|فوضع الكيس على الأرض وانحنى ليلتقط القطعة الصغيرة أمام الملك والملكة.
subtitles.en: The fisherman collected eight thousand dirhams in a sack.|As he left,|a single coin fell,|and he set down the sack to pick it up.

subtitles.ar: قالت شيرين إن الرجل بخيل،|لأنه لم يترك الدرهم لخدم القصر رغم ما حصل عليه من مال.|غضب كسرى، واستدعاه ليسأله كيف اهتم بقطعة صغيرة إلى هذا الحد.
subtitles.en: Shirin called him miserly|for not leaving one coin to the servants.|Angered, Khusrau summoned the fisherman to explain himself.

subtitles.ar: أجاب الصياد أنه لم ينحن طمعًا في المال،|بل لأن على الدرهم صورة الملك واسمه،|وخاف أن يدوس عليه أحد في السوق.|أعجب كسرى بذكائه مرة ثالثة، ومنحه أربعة آلاف إضافية.
subtitles.en: The fisherman said he had rescued the coin|because it bore the king’s image and name,|which might otherwise be trampled.|Khusrau awarded him another four thousand.

subtitles.ar: خرج الصياد ومعه اثنا عشر ألف درهم بدل أربعة آلاف.|وتختم الحكاية بأن الملك أعلن قولًا قاسيًا يلوم فيه نصيحة النساء،|مع أن الأحداث أظهرت بوضوح قدرة الصياد|على تحويل كل اختبار إلى مكافأة.
subtitles.en: The fisherman left with twelve thousand dirhams instead of four.|The old tale ends with the king making a harsh proclamation about women’s advice,|while the fisherman’s cleverness|had won every test.

new_assets.name: fish
new_assets.description: The planned side-view comic fish (shared with KD-007, KD-019, AN-111): palette 2 round and pink, 200 x 110 at s 1, fields limp, eyes, roll, tail swing; plus flat icon mode with a colour override (blue, pink, split) for balloons and clouds.
new_assets.implementation: One function fish(ctx, P): body = shape(ell) with red Ben-Day dots, tail = triangle rotated by a swing angle about the tail root, two fins, eye (x eyes = two short crossed segs), mouth arc. split: draw twice with a clip rect at the body centre line. Register in registry.js.

new_assets.name: sack
new_assets.description: The planned coin sack with fill 0..1, coin mark, optional number tag, tied or loose neck, carried on the back or dropped.
new_assets.implementation: shape() pear outline scaled by fill (width 120..170, height 150..210), neck = small trapezoid with a rope seg, coin mark = yellow circle with a C squiggle, tag = S.label rotated 4 degrees. Use impactSquash for drops; draw after the person for carry-on-back with tip 0.3.

new_assets.name: coin (coinPile single, face:'king')
new_assets.description: Single coin from the planned coinPile with a large portrait state for the insert: crowned bearded head and a squiggle name band.
new_assets.implementation: K circle + rim dots; portrait from 6 shapes (head circle, crown poly, beard wedge, two eye dots, brow line); name = 3 seeded squiggle lines; reveal with a clip rect that sweeps left to right; glint = white diagonal bar clipped to the disc.

new_assets.name: person costume preset 'fisherman'
new_assets.description: Poor fisherman on the Library person figure: short blue-grey tunic, rolled sleeves, rope sash, rolled trousers, bare feet, frayed cap, short beard. Reusable for every fisherman, boatman or porter story.
new_assets.implementation: New entry in the COSTUME table of cast/people.js copied from 'villager' with pal {robe: '#7f95b8', dot: C.blue, sash: '#a8741a', shoes: 'bare', hc: C.white}; opt-in only, so the regression test stays identical.

new_assets.name: iconBalloon (with fish, sack, courtier, scale icons)

new_assets.implementation: Library bubble() outline with an inside(ctx) callback clipped to the balloon; icons are the real props drawn at 0.3 to 0.4 scale (fish, sack, person heads with costume vizier), balanceScale = beam seg + two pan arcs rotating about the pivot with swing().

new_assets.name: fan

new_assets.name: person laugh / templeTap / handOver / carry load

owner_questions: SCRIPT: the English translation is a condensed version of the Arabic (for example P5 omits 'on his shoulder' and 'before the king and queen', P7 omits 'not out of greed', 'in the market' and 'a third time'); both are kept verbatim as supplied.

The king's proclamation about women's advice (P8) is staged wordlessly: a scroll with squiggle lines and the tag A STERN DECREE, with the empty vault and the queen's deadpan look undercutting him; no text of the decree is shown. Default: this softened, king-is-the-joke staging.

Added a palace servant who carries each sack from a treasury door that empties (and receives the rescued coin as a tip at 149.5); he is not named in the script apart from 'the palace servants'. Default: keep him, including the tip.
Male and female are shown as blue and pink fish icons with the English tags MALE? and FEMALE? and the answer as one half blue, half pink fish with BOTH!. Default: these colours and tags.
Shirin is played as a cool schemer with a fan but is never humiliated beyond hiding behind it; the fisherman winks to camera at 157.3. Default: keep both.

Invented lettering beyond the script: RARE!, A PROMISE!, THE TRICK, NO!, NOT ONLY, HA HA!, ONE COIN, MISER!, STAMP!, NOT GREED!, HIS NAME, A STERN DECREE, TEST 1 to 3, plus the numbers. Default: keep all; trim first: STAMP!, THE TRICK, NOT ONLY.
implementation_notes: Start from Library/template. Two baked sets only: palaceHall (palace variant, options in sets.hall) and marketStreet. Read the anchors from palaceHallAnchors(o) and marketStreetAnchors(o) instead of the approximate numbers in this plan.
All cue times are word starts from planning/inputs/timeline.json; build the CUE table from timing.json with w(p, n) and check each against the times written here.

Set LIFE.t = t each frame for auto-blinks; give explicit lid values hand blinks. Every character has a gaze target in every shot (lookAt / gazePlan); the three thinkers use the saccade mode gazePlan(t, plan, 0.07).
The seated royals: person({costume, sit: 1, seat: 'bench', y: sitY}); rise and sit by blending sit with anticipate() and settleTo(). The queen sits on queenSeat (48 high) on the dais.

The order pose (arm snapped toward the vault) must be the identical arm angles at 17.34, 83.86 and 147.2; the servant walk gets slower each time (stride 1.0, 0.8, 0.55) and the vault coinPile lower (n 40, 22, 6, 0).
The fisherman never slides: every move is walk(FX, t) with footfalls; turns use a squeeze flip no narrower than 0.7 as in turnFlip.
The coin: fallY from the sack mouth, two rebound bounces, then roll with rotation = distance / r; the last spin-down must end in the pause 100.86 to 101.66 so the chime at 101.2 is clear of words.
Thought clouds and icon balloons sit in the upper half of the panel; no balloon or lettering may cover a face. Keep figures inside clouds at least 110 px tall on screen.
Counter and tags are drawn in panel space after the camera transform; hit shakes are panel-only (template). Call S.finish last every frame.
Sound: 15 effects, all inside listed pauses (or after the last word); SND master 0.6. If any feels busy against the voice, drop 36.95, 68.3 and 109.7 first.
Subtitles: P1 has four chunks; the Arabic chunk 3 names Shirin while the English names her in chunk 4 (the translation reorders the sentence). Chunk timing follows the Arabic words.
warnings: P8 has no pause of 0.6 s between 150.6 and 175.34, so the ending carries no effects until the final chime at 175.5.
The LATER card at 158.14 lies over the words 158.14 to 160.14 (a long word gap is not listed there); keep it silent and under 1.3 s.
The person figure is front-facing only: the bend for the coin (S11) relies on tip plus a kneel blend; check it reads at phone size with a still at 104.0 and adjust to a full kneel if it does not.
The hall is crowded on the left (door, vault, fisherman, sacks). Check stills at 23.0, 88.3 and 149.9 for overlaps between the sacks and the vault door.
The coin portrait must read at phone size: keep the insert coin at least 330 px across and the portrait in two tones only.
